stories.summary: An improved performance by Hong Kong wasn't enough to beat a determined Tanzania at Tracy Village Sports Ground in their final group match of the ICC World Cricket League Division Three in Darwin.

stories.title: Hong Kong beat Italy in thrilling WCL Div3 warm-up match
stories.subTitle: ICC World Cricket League Division 3 - Darwin, Australia
stories.summary: A rusty looking Hong Kong struggled in the early stages of their warm up match at the ICC World Cricket League Division Three tournament at the Marrar Oval No. 2 Ground in Darwin before pulling off a sensational one wicket victory with 5 balls to spare.
